before.UI: service probes/paths/statistics/warnings only; no four-part version summary
before.dump: Node field only; no version provenance

sources.plugin: package.json belonging to loaded plugin module; name+exact version validation
sources.kernel: current process entry realpath must match confirmed @deepseek-ai/dsh package bin.dsh; read app-boot package metadata resolved from that CLI entry; never import/execute the library

guards: exact SemVer only; no dependency ranges, PATH or dev-peer fallback
stop at first package boundary, maximum 16 levels
ordinary JSON metadata files, nonblocking open, maximum 64KiB
generic read-failure reasons do not echo JSON/provider errors
missing/disposed host clears stale data after refresh
no persistence to private config; no new grants/dependencies/subscriptions

scope: differing CLI and app-boot versions; execute guards

packagedVersionCheck: actual archive is unpacked and collector must report extracted package version/source, current Node, absent host/kernel unavailable

realTui.sourceViewer: keyboard/pager/real SGR entry, wheel, home/end and narrow close checked
files: private panel config after diagnostic tab selection
